verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Amazon IVS has its own programmatic surfaces: a documented data-plane API, chat APIs, CLI commands and EventBridge event rules. Nothing establishes that every console (UI) action is available through the API or CLI, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/console parity, a full control-plane API reference covering channel/stage/recording management, and independent hands-on confirmation of API-only workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
